basis: Frozen numerical gate failed on both tasks; no demonstrated new evidence-to-repair benefit over the same-tool ordinary policy.
scientific_interpretation: No evidence to expand this specific forced-check prompt into a method claim; do not fill remaining time with more seeds or prompt tweaks.
A also spontaneously chose CHECK in every trajectory, so this was structured/mandatory diagnosis versus ordinary tool use, not diagnostics versus no diagnostics.
The one successful check produced real measurements; the subsequent code kept the provisional add-linear direction without satisfying its declared branch condition, and its valid candidate was worse.
The observation channel dropped partial output on errors/timeouts. This limits mechanistic attribution, but does not erase actual costs or justify calling the completed pilot a positive result.
Preserving partial output is a shared future infrastructure fix, not a novel method or a proven performance improvement. It was NOT applied to this batch.

Strong starts were selected on reused exploratory D_search. One start and two generation seeds per task cannot establish policy equivalence, general impossibility, significance or fresh-test transfer.
Near-neighbour methods already cover diagnostic tools, inspection-to-action loops and observation interventions. Novelty is not cleared.
data_notes: census.received_public_metric_text is a non-exhaustive keyword-pattern detector, not proof of absence: episode 7 did emit a baseline OOF value whose line lacked those metric keywords. This flag is not used in any gain, stopping or mechanism decision.
Nominal check timeout was 120 seconds but native polling produced observed execution returns up to 141.96156877209432 seconds. Real elapsed cost was retained, not replaced by nominal caps.
Log stream normalization removes logging indentation/whitespace; hashes do not claim byte-identical recovery of original raw messages.
The client fix test identifies exact working-file bytes; publication may normalize CRLF to LF, checked separately as source-equivalent.
work_left: No further GPU/API/model-fit queued under this pilot. Retain executable-feedback research question only with a distinct, falsifiable intervention that can create decision-relevant evidence cheaply and beat strong ordinary improvement; do not treat additional analyzer engineering as progress toward that claim.
